parsed_response.rationale: The source description identifies four key outcomes: emergency reporting (Emergency Caller), ambulance assignment/dispatch (Dispatcher), location tracking (Ambulance Driver), and recording dispatch data (Radio Operator). All four are explicitly covered by the current HLGs: 'Support rapid emergency initiation', 'Ensure timely ambulance response', 'Enable real-time location tracking', and 'Maintain accurate dispatch data' respectively. No independent functional outcomes are missing.
